articles.summary: TIC Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: TIC) (the “ Company ” or “ TiC Solutions ”), a leading provider of tech-enabled asset integrity, engineering, and geospatial services, announced today that it intends to release its financial results for the third quarter 2026 before the market opens on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Third Quarter Conference Call and Webcast TiC Solutions will hold a webcast/dial-in conference call to discuss its financial results at 8:30 a.m. (Eastern Time) on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Participants on the call will include Ben Heraud, Chief Executive Officer, Kristin Schultes, Chief Financial Officer, and Robert A.E. Franklin, Executive Chairman. To listen to the call by telephone, please dial 800-343-4136 or 203-518-9843 and reference conference ID “TIC”. articles.title: TiC Solutions Confirms Date for Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release
